No brand or model text legible in photo due to watermark overlay and resolution

No visible power cord, plug, or interior view
No grill function or separate grill unit visible in the photo despite seller mentioning 'for both microwave and grill'

No power-on demonstration, interior light, or turntable spin shown

risks.proof: Short video of display lighting up, turntable spinning, and food/water heating

risks.risk: Grill function may be absent or non-functional despite claim
risks.proof: Photo/video of grill element glowing or grill mode selected on panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as microwave-only, grill not working

risks.risk: Door seal/hinge damage not visible due to angle
risks.proof: Close-up photo of door seal and hinge from multiple angles

risks.risk: Interior condition (rust, burnt spots, broken plate) unknown
risks.proof: Photo of open interior including turntable and roof
Clear close-up photo of nameplate/model sticker, usually inside door or on back

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/brand nameplate (usually inside door frame or on the back)
Video of the microwave powering on, running a cycle, and heating something
Photo of the open interior (turntable, walls, roof) for rust/damage
Photo or video showing the grill function activated/heating element
response.reason: Item is clearly identifiable as a generic used microwave by type, but all functional and dual-grill claims are unverified from a single exterior photo, so it must be priced at worst case (non-working, microwave-only) until proof is supplied.
